gate_1_prior_art.action: Preserved as a strong baseline. Not rebranded. Gates 2-4 not run for it, because a known method does not need a novelty pipeline.
gate_1_prior_art.argument: The EWC objective L_new + lambda*sum F_i (theta_i - theta*_i)^2 has proximal step argmin_delta [ g.delta + 0.5 delta^T (2 lambda F) delta ] = -(2 lambda F)^-1 g, which is exactly the navigator update with a diagonal F. The navigator uses the full GGN instead. Same objective, same constraint, same update family; full-versus-diagonal curvature is a known axis (Rotated EWC, K-FAC EWC, natural-gradient transfer).
gate_1_prior_art.result: NOVELTY DEAD, on substance not on names.

gate_random_baseline: In 218 dimensions a random unit vector has expected |cos| ~ 1/sqrt(218) = 0.068. The random control measured -0.057, confirming the scale.

held_out_ood_gain_following_each_proxy.reading: No proxy separates from the random control. Weak alignment does not convert into usable navigation.

proxy_alignments_cos_with_v_true.reading: Best proxy is ~3x the random scale. Everything else is indistinguishable from random.

scope_and_honesty: One system, 218 parameters, five proxy families. Augmentation disagreement, representation stability and explicit symmetry structure were NOT tested. This is a well-controlled negative with a random baseline, not a theorem. The identifiability argument above is the reason to expect it to generalize, and it is an argument, not a proof.
the_boundary_statement: The direction that improves behaviour on distribution Q is a functional of Q. Training data drawn from P cannot determine it without an assumption linking P and Q. The negative result here is therefore not a failure of imagination about proxies; it is an instance of an identifiability limit. Controllability and discoverability come apart: given g_ood the direction is followable very efficiently (up to 35x better Pareto than plain gradient), and without g_ood it is not identifiable from the training-accessible signals tested.
the_deeper_question: Given that controllability was demonstrated, the valuable question is discoverability: can a signal available during ordinary training identify the useful direction WITHOUT observing the OOD objective? Five training-only signal families were tested against the known-good direction v_true = (J^T J + lambda I)^-1 g_ood.
title: Navigator gates: novelty dead at Gate 1; the useful direction is controllable but not discoverable
verdict: NAVIGATOR FAMILY CLOSED in the practically important sense.
what_this_closes: The Navigator family as a practical method. Gate 1 killed the novelty; the discoverability test killed the practical value of the non-novel version, because it requires the OOD gradient it was supposed to help you find.
what_would_reopen_it: A stated, testable assumption linking P and Q that makes the direction identifiable, for example a known symmetry or invariance the shift must respect. That converts an unidentifiable problem into an estimable one, and it is the only route that does not contradict the boundary statement.
